no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Aytu is now a commercial-stage specialty pharmaceutical company. Per FY2025 10-K, the company suspended development of AR101 (enzastaurin) for vascular Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome and on August 5, 2025 transferred all rights, title and interest in AR101 to EnzCo, terminating the Rumpus Asset Purchase Agreement. Remaining business is marketed products: EXXUA (gepirone) for MDD, plus ADHD portfolio (Adzenys, Cotempla) and pediatric portfolio (Karbinal, Poly-Vi-Flor, Tuzistra).
